_comment: v0.5.0 career ranks 1-3. Rank 0 = src/data/professions.he.json unchanged. Titles are working titles; the educator finalizes them. Every liability payment equals principal x BASE_DEBT_RATES (car 2%, student 1%, card 3%) rounded to 10, as validate.js requires.

upgradeLifestyle.perkNote: Round the perk to 100; for example salary 8,800 gives raise 1,056 -> 1,100, new expense about 900, perk about 1,800.

keepLifestyle.shareOfRaiseBecomesMonthlyExpense: 0% (only the tax line should rise, see note)

promotionInGame.reasoning: A 12% bump is smaller than a rank step (20-45%), so a promotion mid-game is a nudge, not a new game; 80% is what a rank step does anyway (expenses = salary / (1 + the profession's free-cash share), so about 83-75% of any extra gross becomes expense), so upgrading keeps the same difficulty as a higher rank and pays a small one-time perk, while keeping the old lifestyle is the honest 'live below your means' choice that makes the game easier and teaches why.
notes: Salary is gross and the game's tax line is an expense: if the engine does not raise the tax line with the raise, the keep-lifestyle option is more generous than 12% suggests. Suggest tax +30% of the raise in both options (marginal income tax plus national insurance in the 14-31% brackets is about 26-43%, ESTIMATE from the 2026 brackets); then the 80% above should be read as 80% of the raise after that tax.

assumptions: Tax line = Israeli 2026 monthly income tax (brackets 10% to 7,010; 14% to 10,060; 20% to 19,000; 31% to 25,100; 35% to 46,690; 47% above) minus 2.25 credit points x 242, plus employee national insurance + health (4.27% to 7,703, 12.17% above), rounded to 50. Brackets and rates VERIFIED in docs/v3/real-world-verified.md. No pension credit, no child credit (child points NOT VERIFIED per v3 notes), no employer pension.
Rank 0 tax lines in the file are within a few tens of shekels of this formula (lawyer 2,400 vs 2,628 is the largest gap, rank 0 left unchanged). The tax line ends at 22-33% of salary at rank 3.

Total expenses per rank = salary / (1 + the profession's rank 0 free-cash share), so the share stays within -0.7 to +0.4 points of rank 0 for all 24 rows. Housing, food, transport grow with a power of the expense growth (about 0.92, 0.6, 0.85), 'other' absorbs the remainder to 100.

Liabilities: only the kinds the validator knows (car, student, card) are used; the kinds are the same as rank 0. NO mortgage-like debt: BASE_DEBT_RATES has no such kind and a starting mortgage is not in the existing data. Car and card principal grow with expense growth to the power 0.8; student loans stay as at rank 0 (a study loan does not grow with a promotion). Savings grow with salary to the power 0.75, perChild with total expenses.
Programmer keeps the extra 'pension' expense id as rank 0 does, scaled with salary.

balanceCheck.method: 300 games per cell, seeds 1000+g*7919, rngVersion 2, 200-turn cap, sensible bot, using the new numbers in a copy of the engine in memory (src untouched). Each cell is median turns / p90 / lost % (/T = games not finished in 200 turns, out of 300). Columns: rank 0, 1, 2, 3.
balanceCheck.finding: Because the win target grows with expenses but deal sizes (cards) stay the same, engineer, programmer and lawyer ranks 2-3 become very hard: programmer rank 3 in full mode needs a median of 111 turns with 51/300 unfinished; lawyer rank 3 full 99 turns with 36/300 unfinished; engineer rank 3 full 59. Teacher, driver, nurse, police and cook stay within about +3 to +9 turns (full) of rank 0. This is harder, not easier, so it satisfies the rule, but it misses the 15-25 turn target (family) for the top three. Options for the CEO: scale deal sizes by rank, shorten the top ladder for those three (rank 3 at about 22,000-24,000 programmer / 21,000-23,000 lawyer), or accept them as 'expert' ranks. The numbers in this file were NOT tuned for turns, only for the share rule.

teacher.sources: Rank 0 anchor: docs/v3/real-world-verified.md (8,800 teacher, VERIFIED tax and NI). Ranks 1-3: role pay for coordinator / deputy / principal. Bizportal gives principal range about 19,000-28,000 gross (undated). NOT VERIFIED: coordinator and deputy figures (searches found no published average); they are estimates, set conservatively below the principal range.

Ranks sit in the lower half of those ranges. Partly verified (ranges), exact column mapping NOT VERIFIED.

Ranks 1-3 are set at or just under those figures. Verified as ranges from a news article, not from the Treasury report itself.
